segment.source: ::The soldier's eyes nearly pop out of their sockets, as though he had never before laid eyes on such a curvy ::<end>
segment.target: ::The soldier's eyes nearly pop out of their sockets, as though he had never before laid eyes on such a curvy ::<end>

segment.source:
::soldier.::
Zhe... zhena? Dugleda da gu prokislo!<end>
segment.target:
::soldier.::
Zhe... zhena? Dugleda da gu prokislo!<end>

segment.source: ::Undo the top button of your uniform.::<end>
segment.target: ::Undo the top button of your uniform.::<end>

segment.source: Ej bre, zheno, schta grduzlikavisch klplna rtbudalatz? ::He takes a step toward you.::<end>
segment.target: Ej bre, zheno, schta grduzlikavisch klplna rtbudalatz? ::He takes a step toward you.::<end>

segment.source: ::Grab him by his collar and kiss him.::<end>
segment.target: ::Grab him by his collar and kiss him.::<end>

segment.source:
::You drag the young and confused soldier toward you and aim your soft lips toward a collision course with his somewhat dry and cracked ones; the result is an explosion of passion, mostly one-sided.
However, his hand slowly reaches behind your head and finds its way underneath the back of your helmet, and you feel him touching your hair...::<end>
segment.target:
::You drag the young and confused soldier toward you and aim your soft lips toward a collision course with his somewhat dry and cracked ones; the result is an explosion of passion, mostly one-sided.
However, his hand slowly reaches behind your head and finds its way underneath the back of your helmet, and you feel him touching your hair...::<end>

segment.source:
::...And yanks it so hard he nearly tears off your entire scalp.::
Ti si zblaknovno miszlela da gu trubnekvnaschisch, a bre? Sagledaschnlk sas balonchad! Razbuna! RAZBUNA!
::You manage to break yourself free of his grasp and prepare for a fight.::<end>
segment.target:
::...And yanks it so hard he nearly tears off your entire scalp.::
Ti si zblaknovno miszlela da gu trubnekvnaschisch, a bre? Sagledaschnlk sas balonchad! Razbuna! RAZBUNA!
::You manage to break yourself free of his grasp and prepare for a fight.::<end>

segment.source: Hey there, handsome. You like the way I fill this uniform, hm?<end>
segment.target: Hey there, handsome. You like the way I fill this uniform, hm?<end>

segment.source: Ti - ti si sagledaschnlk sas balonchad! Razbuna! RAZBUNA!<end>
segment.target: Ti - ti si sagledaschnlk sas balonchad! Razbuna! RAZBUNA!<end>

segment.source:
::officer.::
Zhe... zhena? I *oficir*!? Dugleda da gu prokislo, bre!<end>
segment.target:
::officer.::
Zhe... zhena? I *oficir*!? Dugleda da gu prokislo, bre!<end>

segment.source: Zdrpalno da gu smrdi naglas prokletovagyne gzgne.<end>
segment.target: Zdrpalno da gu smrdi naglas prokletovagyne gzgne.<end>

segment.source: Bletko na mudrac ktrknuo golem prodensckan. Saschkrisch.<end>
segment.target: Bletko na mudrac ktrknuo golem prodensckan. Saschkrisch.<end>

segment.source: Zapovaj bre, kturu gdnem ti na schta proletkas.<end>
segment.target: Zapovaj bre, kturu gdnem ti na schta proletkas.<end>

segment.source: Ej, kud ti zgudnesch prlokpatz? Ne znatnoknem tebigndne schtopschtok.<end>
segment.target: Ej, kud ti zgudnesch prlokpatz? Ne znatnoknem tebigndne schtopschtok.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Rzazrga ti to ne zplno krumpatzgache. Ti u medichnestvno trebasch da gu desch.<end>
segment.target: Rzazrga ti to ne zplno krumpatzgache. Ti u medichnestvno trebasch da gu desch.<end>

segment.source:
::He continues in a serious tone.:: Ali ne trebam klupznovnam ti kuspavno ovde. ::He points toward the stairs.:: Ne slavisch gruzdile hrpave gilomaschkno zlznav. Aj.
::He watches you sternly, waiting for you to leave.::<end>
segment.target:
::He continues in a serious tone.:: Ali ne trebam klupznovnam ti kuspavno ovde. ::He points toward the stairs.:: Ne slavisch gruzdile hrpave gilomaschkno zlznav. Aj.
::He watches you sternly, waiting for you to leave.::<end>

segment.source: Ej, schta to rabotnisch, bre? Kud zgudnesch prlokpatz, zimtzipzam?<end>
segment.target: Ej, schta to rabotnisch, bre? Kud zgudnesch prlokpatz, zimtzipzam?<end>

segment.source: ::He casts a suspicious eye on you, and soon...:: Ti! Ti nesch irgodnegnohlasch da gi buzderam! Razbuna! TREBAM CHUKIPAY!<end>
segment.target: ::He casts a suspicious eye on you, and soon...:: Ti! Ti nesch irgodnegnohlasch da gi buzderam! Razbuna! TREBAM CHUKIPAY!<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and make a carrying gesture.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and make a carrying gesture.::<end>

segment.source: Ih, bre, al ti grlce rzazrga! Schtasch vde u trkorkoborko. Imasch li gu kruslich?<end>
segment.target: Ih, bre, al ti grlce rzazrga! Schtasch vde u trkorkoborko. Imasch li gu kruslich?<end>

segment.source: Zplno, zplno. Nechu kloznim rekozatzkle. Al' kad busch trgnuslomao u magatzinche da gu krslognznorgasch, da gi si prsleo trknogrkche na tuj. Si trgnavo, komvarische? Aj sad...<end>
segment.target: Zplno, zplno. Nechu kloznim rekozatzkle. Al' kad busch trgnuslomao u magatzinche da gu krslognznorgasch, da gi si prsleo trknogrkche na tuj. Si trgnavo, komvarische? Aj sad...<end>

segment.source: A... ko ti gu poslao na prklomazntzku?<end>
segment.target: A... ko ti gu poslao na prklomazntzku?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Grlce ti rzazrga da gu trkslovnadno! Ne bre zplno.<end>
segment.target: Grlce ti rzazrga da gu trkslovnadno! Ne bre zplno.<end>

segment.source: Medichnestvno da gu desch. Ne bejazavay klompaschnek go uradnivno.<end>
segment.target: Medichnestvno da gu desch. Ne bejazavay klompaschnek go uradnivno.<end>

segment.source: Ej, schta to rabotnisch, bre? Daj mu gu zdrnavi kud ti zgudnesch prlokpatz, iliti pznala knuvka?<end>
segment.target: Ej, schta to rabotnisch, bre? Daj mu gu zdrnavi kud ti zgudnesch prlokpatz, iliti pznala knuvka?<end>

segment.source: Nemo da gu izilitkasch. Kud ti zgudnesch prlokpatz? Ne znatnoknem tebigndne schtopschtok.<end>
segment.target: Nemo da gu izilitkasch. Kud ti zgudnesch prlokpatz? Ne znatnoknem tebigndne schtopschtok.<end>

segment.source: I don't speak a word of your language.<end>
segment.target: I don't speak a word of your language.<end>

segment.source: Sch-schta!? Ti si sagledaschnlk! Trebam chukipay! TREBAM CHUKIPAY!<end>
segment.target: Sch-schta!? Ti si sagledaschnlk! Trebam chukipay! TREBAM CHUKIPAY!<end>

segment.source: ::The soldier stands at attention and salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir.<end>
segment.target: ::The soldier stands at attention and salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir.<end>

segment.source: ::He lowers his saluting arm and returns to his duty.::<end>
segment.target: ::He lowers his saluting arm and returns to his duty.::<end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate] Scowl at him without saying anything.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Intimidate] Scowl at him without saying anything.::<end>

segment.source:
::Stiff as a rail, he blankly stares in front of him. You maintain your scowl for a few moments just to see what will happen. Then, like water running down a stalactite, a drop of sweat emerges from beneath his helmet, slides down his cheek and meets his smoothly shaved jawline.
And more soon follow...::<end>
segment.target:
::Stiff as a rail, he blankly stares in front of him. You maintain your scowl for a few moments just to see what will happen. Then, like water running down a stalactite, a drop of sweat emerges from beneath his helmet, slides down his cheek and meets his smoothly shaved jawline.
And more soon follow...::<end>

segment.source: ::Once the sweat begins drizzling all over his uniform he glances into your eyes, but they deflect his stare like a pair of glaring spotlights.::<end>
segment.target: ::Once the sweat begins drizzling all over his uniform he glances into your eyes, but they deflect his stare like a pair of glaring spotlights.::<end>

segment.source: ::As you walk away you hear the sound of him removing his helmet and wiping the sweat off his face.::<end>
segment.target: ::As you walk away you hear the sound of him removing his helmet and wiping the sweat off his face.::<end>

segment.source: ::He remains silent, staring blankly in front of himself. You maintain your scowl for a few moments but receive no reaction from the soldier.::<end>
segment.target: ::He remains silent, staring blankly in front of himself. You maintain your scowl for a few moments but receive no reaction from the soldier.::<end>

segment.source: Eh, komvarische, zdrgachinoslaknrknu sledpo klzno prkuslavcho osch? Oko... ::He takes a look at his watch.:: Sches i satminchetres. Zndrntneche? Da ili ne?<end>
segment.target: Eh, komvarische, zdrgachinoslaknrknu sledpo klzno prkuslavcho osch? Oko... ::He takes a look at his watch.:: Sches i satminchetres. Zndrntneche? Da ili ne?<end>

segment.source: Zplno! Aj s vudregnamo tlepozlniko. Che gu hrngnasch sas Gorko Slimovnknicherga. ::He makes a writing motion with his hand.:: Si trgnavo?<end>
segment.target: Zplno! Aj s vudregnamo tlepozlniko. Che gu hrngnasch sas Gorko Slimovnknicherga. ::He makes a writing motion with his hand.:: Si trgnavo?<end>

segment.source: Zplno. Aj pa grdavaj. Sochijukovnemo sledpo. ::He waves you goodbye.::<end>
segment.target: Zplno. Aj pa grdavaj. Sochijukovnemo sledpo. ::He waves you goodbye.::<end>

segment.source: Bre! Gorko Slimovnknicherga, s lukovnichnem kilo itrista. Gorku da gu si hrngnaschnio. Si trgnavo sad?<end>
segment.target: Bre! Gorko Slimovnknicherga, s lukovnichnem kilo itrista. Gorku da gu si hrngnaschnio. Si trgnavo sad?<end>

segment.source: Eto, aj pa grdavaj. Sochijukovnemo sledpo. ::He waves you goodbye.::<end>
segment.target: Eto, aj pa grdavaj. Sochijukovnemo sledpo. ::He waves you goodbye.::<end>

segment.source: ::Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Bre! Schto ti grlce rzazrga! Ne zplno.<end>
segment.target: Bre! Schto ti grlce rzazrga! Ne zplno.<end>

segment.source: Aj u medichnestvno da gu desch. Ti to travnari zdrvnako kuslavi. Bre... ::He waves you goodbye.::<end>
segment.target: Aj u medichnestvno da gu desch. Ti to travnari zdrvnako kuslavi. Bre... ::He waves you goodbye.::<end>

segment.source: Daj ne kluhdrnaj, komvarische. Schto bre ne valyiadnochesno sas tobom?<end>
segment.target: Daj ne kluhdrnaj, komvarische. Schto bre ne valyiadnochesno sas tobom?<end>

segment.source: ::Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Bre, konachneslo prklezamanzno ihmalo! Ali schto ti grlce rzazrga! Ne zplno.<end>
segment.target: Bre, konachneslo prklezamanzno ihmalo! Ali schto ti grlce rzazrga! Ne zplno.<end>

segment.source: ::He pauses.:: Koj si ti, komvarishe? Zguslavaj thrknoblastimno?<end>
segment.target: ::He pauses.:: Koj si ti, komvarishe? Zguslavaj thrknoblastimno?<end>

segment.source: Staj! Ne mrknesch slugovnatrkno plezno! Razbuna! Trebam chukipay vuslavna! CHUKIPAY!<end>
segment.target: Staj! Ne mrknesch slugovnatrkno plezno! Razbuna! Trebam chukipay vuslavna! CHUKIPAY!<end>

segment.source: Hey there, good fellow! How are you feeling today?<end>
segment.target: Hey there, good fellow! How are you feeling today?<end>

segment.source: ::The soldier stands at attention and salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir. Vam trglasnavno klupsalo, komvarische oficir?<end>
segment.target: ::The soldier stands at attention and salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir. Vam trglasnavno klupsalo, komvarische oficir?<end>

segment.source: Ovaj... Drznam, komvarische oficir. ::He lowers his saluting arm and returns to his duty.::<end>
segment.target: Ovaj... Drznam, komvarische oficir. ::He lowers his saluting arm and returns to his duty.::<end>

segment.source: Komvarische, schto krznesch u schtab natkretnoskalche? Pa jes' hrknusch brljkoszlgnesch prik! Zguslavaj tvoje mve.<end>
segment.target: Komvarische, schto krznesch u schtab natkretnoskalche? Pa jes' hrknusch brljkoszlgnesch prik! Zguslavaj tvoje mve.<end>

segment.source: Drdnesch mene nemozh, sagledaschnlk zlichi! Razbuna! Razbuna!<end>
segment.target: Drdnesch mene nemozh, sagledaschnlk zlichi! Razbuna! Razbuna!<end>

segment.source: Komvarische, schta s klupoznavego u schtab prekon? Daj da gu trtogzlehnotz razglabasch?<end>
segment.target: Komvarische, schta s klupoznavego u schtab prekon? Daj da gu trtogzlehnotz razglabasch?<end>

segment.source: Ej, ej. Komvarische, schta gu rolyatz po magatzin?<end>
segment.target: Ej, ej. Komvarische, schta gu rolyatz po magatzin?<end>

segment.source: ::The soldier stands at attention and salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir. Schta oschte u magatzin rolaytzte junkerischkenter brugdzkzna?<end>
segment.target: ::The soldier stands at attention and salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir. Schta oschte u magatzin rolaytzte junkerischkenter brugdzkzna?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and make a carrying gesture.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and make a carrying gesture.::<end>

segment.source: Ja chu ktlnem gruzdevan, komvarische oficir. Samo zguslavajte na hrunkejuszitz.<end>
segment.target: Ja chu ktlnem gruzdevan, komvarische oficir. Samo zguslavajte na hrunkejuszitz.<end>

segment.source: ::Cough harshly and make a carrying gesture again.::<end>
segment.target: ::Cough harshly and make a carrying gesture again.::<end>

segment.source: Ali... Zplno chegu. Slavajte na gu gtlno presme kaki neche sluvche da krugnjava. ::He salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir.<end>
segment.target: Ali... Zplno chegu. Slavajte na gu gtlno presme kaki neche sluvche da krugnjava. ::He salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir.<end>

segment.source: Komvarische oficir, ja vam moram drguslati rolaytzte drugidaj. Preslem gdugne pogadog.<end>
segment.target: Komvarische oficir, ja vam moram drguslati rolaytzte drugidaj. Preslem gdugne pogadog.<end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate] Scowl at him without saying anything.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Intimidate] Scowl at him without saying anything.::<end>

segment.source: Kom-komvarisch oficir, vi... ::He briefly hesitates.:: Ovaj, hrslajte. Progledache itoriszoknesch ki uslav. ::He salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir.<end>
segment.target: Kom-komvarisch oficir, vi... ::He briefly hesitates.:: Ovaj, hrslajte. Progledache itoriszoknesch ki uslav. ::He salutes you.:: Rad i boj, komvarische oficir.<end>

segment.source: Komvarische oficir, ja ne mogu da gu slednikavam na krosle i gudenche. Zslano mi dayte zaguslajte schta oschte u magatzin rolaytzte?<end>
